title: Defective chips in a sample (binomial)
intro: A wafer process makes 5 % defective chips. An inspector tests 20 chips taken at random. X, the number of defective chips among the 20, is binomial with n = 20 and p = 0.05. The results give the probability of each event for k = 1: exactly one defective chip, at most one, and so on. Module 4 teaches the binomial distribution fully.
